offering_description.value: Sells design, engineering, construction and entertainment software by subscription to architects, engineers, manufacturers and media studios. Delivered as desktop and cloud applications through resellers and its online store.

primary_products.value: CAD software; building information modeling software; product design and simulation software; 3D animation software; construction management software

customer_segment.value: B2B: architecture, engineering and construction firms, manufacturers, media and entertainment studios; B2C: individual designers, hobbyists and freelancers buying individual subscriptions

end_markets.value: architecture, engineering and construction; manufacturing; media and entertainment

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual or monthly software subscriptions, including maintenance and cloud access; service fees: consulting, training and certification fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops design software and cloud platforms, sold to professionals and businesses

geography_served.value: global: customers across the Americas, Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: design and make software lines sharing customers, cloud platform and technology, such as CAD, BIM, manufacturing and media tools

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: authorized resellers and channel partners worldwide; direct sales: sales to large enterprise accounts; online: company website store for direct online purchase and subscriptions

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules, such as data privacy and export control rules
